style: Bohemian style: warm terracotta and cream walls, a honey wooden floor, a white ceiling with a rattan pendant, arched windows, rattan and cane furniture, layered patterned kilim rugs, macramé, warm earthy colours of rust, ochre, olive and deep pink, many green plants in woven baskets. Warm golden daylight. Photorealistic real-estate interior photograph, eye-level wide-angle shot from a corner of the room, showing the floor, two walls and the ceiling. Every piece of furniture stands on its own with some clear space around it, nothing overlapping. No people, no text, no logos, no watermark.
sameHouse: The reference photo shows another room of the same house. Keep exactly the same floor, wall colours and finishes, ceiling, window style, light, colour palette and furniture style, and the same camera height and lens.
